newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 2.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 2.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ended up 0.86 of a point at 7332.04.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index dipped 0.79 of a point to 1,104.83.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5138/48 a dollar at around 0100 GMT, a little weaker from its Kuala Lumpur ending on Friday at 2.5117/27.

* Public Bank said it will continue to separately list the "foreign" tranche of its stock, and that foreign investors have all along been allowed to buy its "local" shares. The statement was to clarify recent market confusion over the foreign and local tranches of the stock.
* Vehicle distributor MBM Resources said it has signed an agreement to buy a 24.88 percent equity in New Zealand's Colonial Motor Co, which has Ford dealerships and truck distribution deals.
* Samanda said it has received conditional regulatory approval for planned acquisition of 11 timber firms.
* Sanda said it has entered a memorandum of understanding with Oakwell of Singapore to build two power plant barges in an Indian state.
* Phileo Allied reported net profit of 32.65 million ringgit for the year ended January 31, 1997, against 43.81 the previous year.
